questions.original: Oppression by corporations is more of a concern than oppression by governments.
questions.stem: 企業造成的壓迫比政府造成的壓迫更值得擔憂。

questions.original: It is necessary for the government to intervene in the economy to protect consumers.
questions.stem: 政府有必要介入經濟以保護消費者。

questions.original: The freer the markets, the freer the people.
questions.stem: 市場越自由，人民就越自由。

questions.original: It is better to maintain a balanced budget than to ensure welfare for all citizens.
questions.stem: 維持預算平衡比確保全體國民的福利更重要。

questions.original: Publicly-funded research is more beneficial to the people than leaving it to the market.
questions.stem: 由公共經費支持的研究，比交給市場更能造福人民。

questions.original: Tariffs on international trade are important to encourage local production.
questions.stem: 對國際貿易課徵關稅，對鼓勵本地生產很重要。

questions.original: From each according to his ability, to each according to his needs.
questions.stem: 各盡所能，各取所需。

questions.original: It would be best if social programs were abolished in favor of private charity.
questions.stem: 最好廢除社會福利計畫，改由民間慈善取代。

questions.original: Taxes should be increased on the rich to provide for the poor.
questions.stem: 應該對富人加稅來照顧窮人。

questions.original: Inheritance is a legitimate form of wealth.
questions.stem: 繼承是正當的財富來源。

questions.original: Basic utilities like roads and electricity should be publicly owned.
questions.stem: 道路、電力等基礎設施應該公有。

questions.original: Government intervention is a threat to the economy.
questions.stem: 政府干預是經濟的威脅。

questions.original: Those with a greater ability to pay should receive better healthcare.
questions.stem: 付得起更多錢的人，應該得到更好的醫療照護。

questions.original: Quality education is a right of all people.
questions.stem: 接受良好的教育是所有人的權利。

questions.original: The means of production should belong to the workers who use them.
questions.stem: 生產工具應該屬於使用它們的勞工。

questions.original: The United Nations should be abolished.
questions.stem: 應該廢除聯合國。

questions.original: Military action by our nation is often necessary to protect it.
questions.stem: 我國經常需要採取軍事行動來保護自己。

questions.original: I support regional unions, such as the European Union.
questions.stem: 我支持區域性的聯盟，例如歐盟。

questions.original: It is important to maintain our national sovereignty.
questions.stem: 維護我國的主權很重要。

questions.original: A united world government would be beneficial to mankind.
questions.stem: 統一的世界政府對人類有益。

questions.original: It is more important to retain peaceful relations than to further our strength.
questions.stem: 維持和平關係比增強國力更重要。

questions.original: Wars do not need to be justified to other countries.
questions.stem: 戰爭不需要向其他國家說明正當理由。

questions.original: Military spending is a waste of money.
questions.stem: 軍事支出是浪費錢。

questions.original: International aid is a waste of money.
questions.stem: 國際援助是浪費錢。

questions.original: My nation is great.
questions.stem: 我的國家很偉大。

questions.original: Research should be conducted on an international scale.
questions.stem: 研究應該在國際規模上進行。

questions.original: Governments should be accountable to the international community.
questions.stem: 各國政府應該對國際社會負責。

questions.original: Even when protesting an authoritarian government, violence is not acceptable.
questions.stem: 即使是抗議威權政府，暴力也不可接受。

questions.original: My religious values should be spread as much as possible.
questions.stem: 我的宗教價值應該盡可能地傳播出去。

questions.original: Our nation's values should be spread as much as possible.
questions.stem: 我國的價值應該盡可能地傳播出去。

questions.original: It is very important to maintain law and order.
questions.stem: 維持法律與秩序非常重要。

questions.original: The general populace makes poor decisions.
questions.stem: 一般大眾常做出不好的決定。

questions.original: Physician-assisted suicide should be legal.
questions.stem: 醫師協助自殺應該合法。

questions.original: The sacrifice of some civil liberties is necessary to protect us from acts of terrorism.
questions.stem: 為了防範恐怖攻擊，犧牲部分公民自由是必要的。

questions.original: Government surveillance is necessary in the modern world.
questions.stem: 在現代世界，政府監控是必要的。

questions.original: The very existence of the state is a threat to our liberty.
questions.stem: 國家的存在本身就威脅我們的自由。

questions.original: Regardless of political opinions, it is important to side with your country.
questions.stem: 不論政治意見為何，與自己的國家站在同一邊很重要。

questions.original: All authority should be questioned.
questions.stem: 所有權威都應該接受質疑。

questions.original: A hierarchical state is best.
questions.stem: 階層分明的國家最好。

questions.original: It is important that the government follows the majority opinion, even if it is wrong.
questions.stem: 即使多數意見是錯的，政府也應該依循多數意見。

questions.original: The stronger the leadership, the better.
questions.stem: 領導越強勢越好。

questions.original: Democracy is more than a decision-making process.
questions.stem: 民主不只是一種做決定的程序。

questions.original: Environmental regulations are essential.
questions.stem: 環境法規不可或缺。

questions.original: A better world will come from automation, science, and technology.
questions.stem: 自動化、科學與科技會帶來更好的世界。

questions.original: Children should be educated in religious or traditional values.
questions.stem: 應該以宗教或傳統價值教育兒童。

questions.original: Traditions are of no value on their own.
questions.stem: 傳統本身沒有價值。

questions.original: Religion should play a role in government.
questions.stem: 宗教應該在政府中扮演一定角色。

questions.original: Churches should be taxed the same way other institutions are taxed.
questions.stem: 宗教團體應該和其他機構一樣課稅。

questions.original: Climate change is currently one of the greatest threats to our way of life.
questions.stem: 氣候變遷是目前威脅我們生活方式最大的問題之一。

questions.original: It is important that we work as a united world to combat climate change.
questions.stem: 團結全世界共同對抗氣候變遷很重要。

questions.original: Society was better many years ago than it is now.
questions.stem: 多年前的社會比現在好。

questions.original: It is important that we maintain the traditions of our past.
questions.stem: 維護過去的傳統很重要。

questions.original: It is important that we think in the long term, beyond our lifespans.
questions.stem: 我們應該做長遠的思考，考慮到我們這一生之後的事。

questions.original: Reason is more important than maintaining our culture.
questions.stem: 理性比維護我們的文化更重要。

questions.original: Drug use should be legalized or decriminalized.
questions.stem: 使用毒品應該合法化或除罪化。

questions.original: Same-sex marriage should be legal.
questions.stem: 同性婚姻應該合法。

questions.original: No cultures are superior to others.
questions.stem: 沒有哪一種文化比其他文化優越。

questions.original: Sex outside marriage is immoral.
questions.stem: 婚外性行為是不道德的。

questions.original: If we accept migrants at all, it is important that they assimilate into our culture.
questions.stem: 如果要接納移民，移民同化到我們的文化中很重要。

questions.original: Abortion should be prohibited in most or all cases.
questions.stem: 墮胎在大多數或所有情況下都應該禁止。

questions.original: Gun ownership should be prohibited for those without a valid reason.
questions.stem: 沒有正當理由的人應該禁止擁有槍枝。

questions.original: I support single-payer, universal healthcare.
questions.stem: 我支持單一保險人的全民健康保險。

questions.original: Prostitution should be illegal.
questions.stem: 性交易應該違法。

questions.original: Maintaining family values is essential.
questions.stem: 維護家庭價值不可或缺。

questions.original: To chase progress at all costs is dangerous.
questions.stem: 不計代價地追求進步是危險的。

questions.original: Genetic modification is a force for good, even on humans.
questions.stem: 基因改造是一股正面的力量，即使用在人類身上也一樣。

questions.original: We should open our borders to immigration.
questions.stem: 我們應該開放邊境，接納移民。

questions.original: Governments should be as concerned about foreigners as they are about their own citizens.
questions.stem: 政府關心外國人的程度，應該和關心本國國民一樣。

questions.original: All people - regardless of factors like culture or sexuality - should be treated equally.
questions.stem: 不論文化或性傾向等因素，所有人都應該得到平等對待。

questions.original: It is important that we further my group's goals above all others.
questions.stem: 最重要的是推進我所屬群體的目標，其他群體在其次。

references.name: 史達林主義／毛澤東主義
